mapper.sql: win_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.ladder_score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.ladder_score::text) AS INT) > 0 GROUP BY u.wizard_id )
